title: F2R - bridge teacher-student causale (student 35D deployable, teacher privilegiato A_iso6clk), protocollo rev3 preregistrato
stage_authorised: S0 only: tooling + synthetic tests + dry-run (no rollout, no env stepping, no real P0, no real refit, no training, no production change)

rules: seed 125: never in any dataset, label, fit, aggregation, batch selection or tuning; used only as go/no-go promotion gate V; its traces generate no labels/datasets
seeds 126-128: sealed until F3, opened once
deterministic rollouts (seed 123) are training side: gate measurement A/B/C and, when preregistered, aggregation; they are not validation

teacher.name: V26_39D
teacher.fed_with: 4 prescribed targets at 2:6 + prescribed right clock at 0:2 (= A_iso6clk)
teacher.evaluation: offline numpy float64 forward on the student's visited obs35 (float32-cast), torch-path deviation <= 1e-5 verified in F1

anchors.policy: only the three existing A_iso6clk traces (F1 aiso_clk_diag), content-addressed; no new stochastic teacher rollouts before tooling, P0 and T1 commissioning are audited

action_semantics.decode: q_j = low_j + 0.5*(a_j + 1)*(high_j - low_j) per joint (knee q = 0.75 a - 0.75; ankle q = 0.7 a); clip a to [-1,1]; knee flexion negative; ankle negative = plantarflexion
action_semantics.slew: per component, 2.5 rad/s knee and 2.0 rad/s ankle relative to the previous policy endpoint (feature 25/30), dt 0.01 s
action_semantics.ik_teacher: u_IK(t) = encode(q_IK(t + 0.01 s + lookahead)), lookahead 0.0 s (July teacher_summary), q_IK = prescribed prosthetic IK (base_kin, 6 Hz low-pass)
action_semantics.composition: per-joint composition of absolute position targets is well posed at command level (component-wise decode/clip/slew); behavioural equivalence is NOT assumed: T2 needs its own closed-loop gates

T1R.role: corrective commissioning (architect decision 2026-08-23, report sections 14.15-14.16): one corrective refit + 3 deterministic rollouts + gate A; B/C informative; STOP always; unlocks T2 only on A PASS
T1R.label: knee = u_T, ankle = u_IK (task role); preservation role target = recorded JUL_H0 action (never u_T)
T1R.init: JUL_H0 (theta_0, actor digest a0801a9e…), never the T1 student
T1R.stop: always (commissioning): no dataset aggregation, no promotion in the T2 sense, no T3 trigger

dataset.task: 3 pinned A_iso6clk anchors (purpose anchor, seed 123) + on-policy states of the 3 pinned T1 deterministic rollouts (purpose det, seed 123), labels knee u_T / ankle u_IK with exact t_pre lookup on the privileged caches
dataset.preservation: the 3 pinned JUL_H0 deterministic F0 jobs (seed 123), target = recorded raw_policy_action (deterministic mean), separated from the task labels
dataset.dedup: within role by bitwise input (first kept; identical inputs with different targets -> fail closed); cross-role: the 3 reset-row collisions (one per start, t_pre == reset time, step 1) are removed from the task role and preservation wins; each collision reported with input sha256, both targets and their delta
dataset.seeds: 123 only; 124 unused (no stochastic rollouts exist); 125 and 126-128 never

T1R.loss: L = mean_j E_task[(m_j - y_j)^2]/Var_task_j + beta * mean_j E_pres[(m_j - a_j)^2]/Var_pres_j + lambda_phi*L_aux + lambda_clip*clip + lambda_a*||theta - theta_0||^2; per-joint variances fixed a priori from the training rows; L_task and L_pres are per-role per-joint means (group-balanced, not row-count weighted); masks separate the roles
T1R.beta_rationale: equal weight of the two dimensionless (1 - R^2 like) terms, chosen a priori; sensitivities 0.5/2 reported descriptively only, no adaptive sweep on the gate
T1R.budget: frozen refit_budget (300 epochs, batch 256, Adam lr 1e-4, seed 2026, clip_weight 1.0, lambda_phi 0.1, lambda_anchor 1e-3 kept for continuity)

criteria.rule: P1, P2, P3, P3b and P4 all mandatory; any FAIL -> no export, no rollout

T1R.rollouts: exactly 3 deterministic seed-123 rollouts (STUDENT_T1R_r1__v3_canonical__<start>__det), GATE-ONLY: enters_dataset false, generates_labels false, never aggregated; no stochastic, no seed 125
T1R.gate: A (hard, A6 with the unwrapped estimator); B and C computed as informative; V/R NOT_EVALUATED; unlock_t2 = A.pass; promotion never; t3_trigger never
T1R.unlock_rule: T2 round 1 may start from the T1R student ONLY behind a verified T1R gate artefact with A PASS (exactly one gate_T1R_round_1_*.json, records' trace digests = disk, receipts ok/seed 123/det referencing the T1R module digest); otherwise T2 round 1 is locked (fail-closed, no fallback)

orchestration_attempt_1.outcome: aborted in driver preflight (fail-closed), zero rollouts, no simulation process

closed_loop_rollout_attempt.rule: the next matrix --execute --phase T1R --round 1 after the architect's audit is the FIRST AND ONLY closed-loop rollout attempt of T1R (3 det seed-123 gate-only rollouts); no retry

T3.label: u_IK both joints
T3.trigger: T2 passes A and fails B3, or preregistered equivalent diagnosis: B2 and/or B5 FAIL with A PASS

hard_constraints: W1[:,0:2] == 0 after every optimiser step and at export
no prescribed clock/targets/time/index in the input

export.invariance_test: mu(x) bit-identical under perturbation of indices 0:2

refit_budget.loss: mean||mu - u*||^2 + clip_weight*mean relu(|mu|-1)^2 + lambda_phi*mean||h - c(t)||^2 + lambda_anchor*||theta - theta_{r-1}||^2

dataset.D_next: D_r union labelled rows of the student's seed-123 det and seed-123/124 stochastic rollouts of round r; seed 125 never
dataset.labels: actions only (no feature leakage); obs35 float32-cast
dataset.T1R: two roles (task / preservation) as in variants.T1R.dataset; never aggregated into D_r of T2

p0.data: JUL_H0 deterministic F0 jobs under v3 (3 starts) = test states; anchors A_iso6clk (3 starts) fixed in train
p0.folds: LOSO over the 3 JUL_H0 starts: train = the OTHER two JUL_H0 starts + the 3 anchors MINUS exactly one row, the same-start anchor reset row (amendment B, see amendment_B_reset_row); test = the held-out JUL_H0 start only, FULL (reset row included); standardisation fitted on train only; no held-out row anywhere in train/standardisation/selection (strict bitwise row assert applied after the exclusion)

amendment_B_reset_row.decision: architect, option B (scientific: the reset state is relevant to the online bootstrap problem and must remain in TEST)
amendment_B_reset_row.timing: pre-metric: adopted after the first real P0 attempt (2026-08-23T15:02:11Z) failed closed at the leakage assert in the first fold BEFORE any estimator was fitted or any metric computed; no P0 artefact was produced
amendment_B_reset_row.evidence: read-only diagnosis: in every fold exactly one bitwise collision = row 0 (first pre-action observation, t_pre == reset time) of the held-out JUL_H0 start vs row 0 of the same-start A_iso6clk anchor; the env reset is policy-independent (reset diagnostics SHA equal: 42d07621…, 3d3b8dfa…, 614e0e5c…); rows diverge from index 1; no other duplicate within or across trajectories
amendment_B_reset_row.rule: in each LOSO fold, TRAIN excludes exactly one row: index 0 of the anchor of the held-out start; TEST is unchanged (500/500/176 rows, reset row included); the other two JUL_H0 starts and the remaining 1499 anchor rows are retained

excluded_row.definition: first pre-action observation with t_pre == reset time of the held-out start, bitwise identical to held-out test row 0

structural_validation_fail_closed: time provenance (t_pre, reset_time) present on the held-out test and the same-start anchor
t_pre[0] == reset_time on both and equal across the two
anchor row 0 bitwise identical to held-out test row 0 (missing expected reset duplicate -> fail)
anchor row 0 unique within the anchor and test row 0 unique within the test set (ambiguity -> fail)
exactly one full-row collision before the exclusion
after the exclusion: no held-out row bitwise present in train (full rows and selected columns); any additional or non-reset duplicate -> fail

p0.label: c(t_pre) prescribed from the 125 right heel strikes (offset 0), computed offline; never a feature
p0.metric: circular error |phi_hat - phi| mod 1, phi_hat = atan2(sin, cos)/2pi

thresholds_frozen.rule: >= 2 folds of 3 (MLP), fold +0.20 always reported, computed once with frozen hyperparameters

p0.fail_meaning: stateless 35D contract insufficient -> architectural decision before any rollout

gates.aggregation_rule: per start on the 3 deterministic rollouts (seed 123); phase-aligned metrics = median over that start's valid cycles; a start without valid cycles FAILS that metric; '2of3' or 'all3' as indicated

amendment_A6_unwrap.decision: architect (authorised after the T1 commissioning audit)
amendment_A6_unwrap.rule: drift = linear slope vs time of the UNWRAPPED circular difference ((prescribed - online + 0.5) mod 1) - 0.5, numpy.unwrap on 2*pi*diff / 2*pi, over the rows after the online clock became informative, excluding saturated (0,1) rows; threshold 0.055 cycle/s and the period band [1.45, 1.70] s unchanged; no other threshold changed
amendment_A6_unwrap.reason: the offset between the online (prosthetic heel-strike) clock and the prescribed (sound-side) clock is physiologically ~0.42-0.48 cycle; when it crosses +-0.5 the centred difference flips sign mid-series and the fitted slope is inflated (T1 student minus020: +0.423 wrapped vs -0.063 unwrapped; JUL_H0 minus020: +0.450 vs -0.031); anchors unaffected (-0.019..-0.027 both ways)
amendment_A6_unwrap.evidence: report section 14.13; T1 gate recomputed from the existing artefacts only (no rollout): verdict unchanged (A FAIL: A5 nominal; A6 periods 1.421/1.105 out of band, drift -0.063/+0.111 beyond 0.055)
amendment_A6_unwrap.fail_closed: slope None (A6 FAIL) on fewer than 2 informative rows, degenerate time span or non-finite values; legacy wrapped slope kept in the record for audit only

V.semantics: held-out promotion gate: FAIL blocks promotion to R/F3; never used for fit/aggregation/batch selection/tuning; generates no labels/datasets

R.note: the 3 seed-125 jobs are those of V (no new 125 collection); only for a round that passed A, B, C and V
